attempts.summary: Repaired node1’s support-bundle exporter and verified it persists across reboot. It now redacts email addresses and auth_token values, preserves timestamps/event types/ticket IDs, exports nested logs, and excludes symlinks outside logs/. Source data, RHEL 10.0, and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remain unchanged.
